name: Proto-Palkia
look: a massive Palkia of rose-pink crystal veined in glowing magenta and flecked with stars, glowing shoulder pearls and two jagged fans of translucent magenta crystal spread behind it
entry: A Pokémon resembling Palkia, described in an ancient star chart as a giant of rose crystal whose wings tore the sky open. Shards of other places drift around it wherever it stands.
how: Wild: very rare at dusk on mountain peaks.
